faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about our services.

items.question: How much does a garden design cost?
items.answer: The cost depends on the space size, type of garden, plants, planters, materials and level of customization. You can use our Garden Cost Calculator for an initial estimate, or request a free consultation for an accurate quotation.

items.question: Do you provide maintenance services?
items.answer: Yes. We offer regular maintenance visits and annual plans tailored to your garden, including pruning, plant health checks and seasonal care.

items.question: What types of plants do you use?
items.answer: We select plants to suit your space, local climate, light levels and care preferences, with native and water-wise options where appropriate.

items.question: How long does installation take?
items.answer: Timing depends on the size and complexity of your project. We provide a clear schedule after assessing the space and finalizing the design.

items.question: Can you work with small spaces?
items.answer: Absolutely. We design for compact balconies, patios and corners with space-smart layouts, vertical planting and carefully chosen containers.

items.question: Do you provide a free consultation?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a free initial consultation to understand your space, goals and budget before recommending the next steps.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how Decor-Plants handles information when you visit this website or contact us about garden, plant-care, and landscaping services in Pune.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: If you complete the enquiry form, it may include your name, phone number, email address, property type, city, approximate area, requested service, and any message you enter. The email field is optional. Please avoid including sensitive personal information in your enquiry.

sections.heading: How the enquiry form works
paragraphs: When you submit the form, this website creates a pre-filled message and opens WhatsApp. The details are included in the WhatsApp link; you can review them and choose whether to send the message. The website does not send the message automatically or store enquiry submissions in its own database.
Scanning the WhatsApp QR code opens the Decor-Plants WhatsApp contact. Scanning it alone does not send your details; information is shared when you choose to message us through WhatsApp.

sections.heading: How we use enquiry information
paragraphs: If you send us a WhatsApp message, we use the information you choose to provide to respond to your enquiry, discuss your project, prepare a quotation, and arrange follow-up about the requested service.

sections.heading: WhatsApp and other providers
paragraphs: WhatsApp is operated by Meta. When you open WhatsApp or send us a message, WhatsApp processes information under its own terms and privacy policy.

This website loads fonts from Google Fonts. Our hosting provider may process routine technical request information, such as IP address, browser details, and request time, to deliver and protect the website. Those providers handle information under their own policies.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The current website code does not configure advertising or analytics tracking or save enquiry form data in cookies or browser storage. Your browser, hosting provider, or third-party services may process technical information needed to operate their services.

sections.heading: Retention and your choices
paragraphs: The website itself does not retain enquiry submissions. If you send us a WhatsApp message, the message may remain in your and our WhatsApp chat history. You can choose not to submit the form or send a message. WhatsApp controls its own records and retention.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: The form hands off information to WhatsApp rather than storing it on this website. No method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely risk-free, so share only details needed for your enquiry.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our website or enquiry process changes. The date above indicates when it was last updated.

termsAndConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
introParagraphs: Welcome to Decor-Plants. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our website, as well as the garden maintenance, landscaping, balcony and terrace garden design, and plant-care services provided by Decor-Plants in Pune, Maharashtra.

By accessing our website, submitting an enquiry, or booking our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our website or engage our services.

sections.heading: 1. Services & Scope of Work
sections.intro: Decor-Plants provides residential and commercial gardening services, including but not limited to:
list: Routine garden and lawn maintenance
Balcony and terrace garden design and setup
Indoor and outdoor plant care and procurement
Vertical green wall installations
Pruning, trimming, and shaping
Soil conditioning, fertilization, and organic pest management
Garden rejuvenation and soft landscaping
sections.footer: The specific scope of work, deliverables, schedules, and costs for any project will be outlined in a formal quotation, project estimate, or service agreement provided to the client.

sections.heading: 2. Consultations, Site Visits & Quotations
paragraphs: Initial estimates provided online or through WhatsApp are approximate and based solely on information and photos provided by the client. An on-site inspection may be required to evaluate sunlight exposure, drainage, site accessibility, and exact dimensions.

Written quotations are valid for 15 calendar days from the date of issuance unless otherwise stated. Any modifications to project scope, plant varieties, or materials requested by the client after approval may result in adjusted pricing and delivery timelines.

sections.heading: 3. Client Responsibilities & Site Access
sections.intro: To ensure the timely and safe completion of work, the client agrees to:
list: Provide safe and unobstructed access to the work area (gardens, balconies, terraces, courtyards, or office spaces) during agreed working hours.
Provide adequate water supply and electrical access necessary for plant care, irrigation, and installation equipment without charge.

Secure all required permissions, approvals, or No Objection Certificates (NOC) from housing society committees, building managements, or landlords regarding weight restrictions, drilling, or material movement.
Notify our team in advance of any concealed water pipes, electrical cables, fragile waterproof membranes, or hazardous site conditions.

sections.heading: 4. Living Goods & Plant Care Disclaimer
paragraphs: Plants, shrubs, turf, and trees are living biological organisms. Their health, growth, and survival depend significantly on ambient environmental factors such as adequate natural light, watering frequency, drainage, temperature, humidity, and ongoing care.
Decor-Plants guarantees that all plants supplied are healthy, viable, and free from pests and diseases at the time of delivery and installation.
Following handover, Decor-Plants cannot be held responsible for plant deterioration or loss caused by:
list: Over-watering, under-watering, or irregular watering by the client
Inadequate natural sunlight or extreme indoor air-conditioning
Severe weather events, including heavy monsoon waterlogging, hail, or heatwaves
Infestations, fungal disease, or pet and rodent damage
Use of unauthorized chemical fertilizers or pesticides
sections.footer: Free plant replacement is not provided unless explicitly included as part of an active Decor-Plants Maintenance Agreement.

sections.heading: 5. Periodic Maintenance Contracts
paragraphs: Clients subscribed to recurring maintenance packages (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly) receive scheduled visits for weeding, soil aeration, pruning, nutrient application, and pest inspection.

If a scheduled visit cannot occur due to client unavailability or denied access, we will make reasonable efforts to reschedule within the same billing cycle. However, visits missed due to client fault are not eligible for fee deductions or refunds.

sections.heading: 6. Pricing, Payments & Deposits
sections.intro: Prices for our services and products are quoted in Indian Rupees (INR).
list: Custom Projects & Installations: An advance deposit (typically 50%) is required prior to plant procurement and site preparation. The remaining balance is due immediately upon project completion or according to agreed project milestones.
Ongoing Maintenance: Maintenance services are billed in advance on a monthly or quarterly cycle.
Payment Modes: We accept payments via UPI, bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS), and cash.
sections.footer: Decor-Plants reserves the right to pause ongoing maintenance visits or delay installation schedules if scheduled payments remain outstanding.

sections.heading: 7. Rescheduling & Weather Disruptions
paragraphs: Clients may reschedule a service visit by notifying us at least 24 hours prior to the appointment.

For outdoor projects and terrace gardens, Decor-Plants reserves the right to postpone scheduled work in case of adverse weather conditions (such as torrential rainfall, thunderstorms, or extreme heat) to protect personnel safety and plant integrity. Rescheduled dates will be coordinated with the client promptly.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.intro: While our team exercises utmost care and professionalism on site, Decor-Plants shall not be held liable for:
list: Pre-existing civil defects, roof seepage, or structural weaknesses not caused by our installation.
Damage to concealed plumbing or electrical lines that were not disclosed to our team in advance.
Indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from service delays due to weather, transport delays, or supply chain shortages.
sections.footer: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable Indian law, Decor-Plants' total aggregate liability for any claim arising out of our services shall not exceed the total fees paid by the client for the specific service or project in dispute.

sections.heading: 9. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: All content on this website—including photographs, logo, branding, text, graphics, design layouts, and project showcases—is the property of Decor-Plants and protected by applicable copyright and intellectual property laws. You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, or publish any content from this site without our prior written consent.

sections.heading: 10. Third-Party Services & WhatsApp
paragraphs: Our website utilizes WhatsApp (Meta) to facilitate direct communication and quote requests. When communicating via WhatsApp, you are subject to Meta's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 11. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms and any disputes arising out of or related to our services shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. The courts of Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes or legal proceedings.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: Decor-Plants reserves the right to revise these Terms & Conditions at any time. Changes will be posted to this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Continued use of our website or services following any changes indicates your acceptance of the revised terms.
